# monitor-adjustments.json

*Generated by `tools/Generate-MonitorTagDocs.ps1` - do not edit by hand.*

Per-monitor tuning of the taskbar, kept in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\RetroBar\monitor-adjustments.json` and read again whenever it is saved.
It is keyed by the monitor's device name (`\\.\DISPLAY1`), then by a tag; a tag is on an element in the XAML (`utilities:MonitorOffset.Tag`).

```json
{
  "\\\\.\\DISPLAY1": {
    "HeightAdjustment": 1.6,
    "MediaTrackText": { "ScrollSpeed": 30, "ScrollPause": 2, "Y": 0 },
    "MediaSeekTimeText": { "FontFamily": "Tahoma", "Bold": true, "X": 0, "Y": 0.8 }
  }
}
```

Values are in DIPs (1 DIP is 1.25 pixels at 125% scale), so `0.8` is one pixel there.
A monitor can also have `RowCount` (the number of taskbar rows) and `HeightAdjustment` (DIPs added to the taskbar's height).

## Fields of a tag

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `X` | double | Horizontal nudge in DIPs (a render transform: the layout is not changed, so nothing else moves). |
| `Y` | double | Vertical nudge in DIPs (a render transform: the layout is not changed, so nothing else moves). |
| `Width` | double? | A width in DIPs, as if set in the XAML (layout: what is next to the element moves). |
| `Height` | double? | A height in DIPs, as if set in the XAML (layout: what is next to the element moves). |
| `ScrollSpeed` | double? | For the "MediaTrackText" tag only: how fast a media text too long for its room slides, in DIPs a second (30 if omitted), on this monitor's taskbar and in its popup. |
| `ScrollPause` | double? | For the "MediaTrackText" tag only: how long the slide waits at each end, in seconds (2 if omitted). |
| `Scale` | double? | Uniform render-time scale multiplier (1 = no change), applied around the element's center. |
| `TextRendering` | string | A System.Windows.Media.TextRenderingMode name (Auto/Aliased/Grayscale/ClearType), or null to leave it inherited. |
| `BitmapScaling` | string | A System.Windows.Media.BitmapScalingMode name (NearestNeighbor/Linear/HighQuality/Fant), or null to leave it inherited. |
| `Bold` | bool? | true for bold text, false for normal, or null to leave it inherited. |
| `FontSize` | double? | Font size in DIPs, or null to leave the element's own Style/XAML FontSize alone. |
| `FontFamily` | string | A font family name (e.g. "Tahoma", "Consolas") or null to leave the element's own Style/XAML FontFamily alone. |
| `Margin` | string | A WPF Thickness string ("5", "5,0", or "5,0,0,0" - same syntax as a plain XAML Margin="..." attribute), or null to leave the element's own Style/XAML Margin alone. |
| `Padding` | string | A WPF Thickness string (same syntax as Margin), applied to the element's own Padding property, or null to leave the element's own Style/XAML Padding alone. |
| `Background` | string | A WPF color string - "#RRGGBB", "#AARRGGBB", or a named color like "Red" - applied to the element's own Background property, or null to leave its Style/XAML background alone. |
| `Geometry` | string | WPF path mini-language Figures (the same syntax as a PathGeometry's own Figures="..." - e.g. "M 0,0 L 6,3.5 L 0,7 Z"), applied to the element's own Data property to replace its vector shape entirely, or null to leave the element's own Style/XAML geometry alone. |
| `Blur` | double? | Gaussian blur radius in device-independent pixels (0 or null = none). |

## Tags
